text_block_list.text: While out on a walk, I caught sight of Symboli Kris S and Fine Motion.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm! I think we got a really wonderful photo desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Yeah. Another memory... added to the scrapbook.
choice_data_list: Is that the one you're sending to your mentor?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Trainer... from back then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Thanks to your advice... it has changed――significantly.
The scrapbook she showed me was still in progress, but it conveyed her journey with a genuine warmth.
choice_data_list: It's wonderful. I'm sure they'll love it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Photographs convey... emotions, the scenery of the time――a great deal.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes. Giving shape to all sorts of memories... I want to make a scrapbook that will be lovely to look back on after returning to Ireland desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: So let's take lots and lots of pictures, okay?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――...Yeah. However... what should we capture next――
choice_data_list: ...Um, is there something on my face?
...Um, is there something on my face?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――To someone in the position of a mentor... I wish to ask. What kind of photo of a student... brings you joy?
choice_data_list: In that case, photos of you having fun!
In that case, cool photos might be great.

text_block_list.text: Seeing a student enjoying their academy life to the fullest warms a trainer's heart. Though there were other options, that's what I answered.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Indeed. ...I learned that once before.
Oho, what's all this! Looks like you're up to something rather entertaining!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text: A photographic autobiography of reminiscence, is it... In that case!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text: The presence of those of us who rivaled you in the ecstatic, intoxicating waltz of dance's delight is indispensable... would you not agree?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――The soirée was splendid... You two are... indispensable pieces in the trajectory of my mission.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu, then I'll make sure to take a wonderful picture of the three of you having fun♪

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Haha! More! Bare your heart to the world...!

text_block_list.name: Tani no Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ――Fuhahaha! Feel it, the pulsating rhythm! The intoxicating euphoria of youth!
Dancing amidst the playful antics, Symboli Kris S looked like any ordinary student enjoying academy life.
choice_data_list: Looks like you're enjoying school life to the fullest.
Looks like you're enjoying school life to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――A reply letter... arrived from my mentor.
'I am glad to see you living such a fulfilling academy life. Keep giving it your all'――it said.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――...I am glad I made it.
Seeing a student striking a cool, confident pose brings genuine joy to a trainer. Though there were other options, that's what I answered.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――My mentor may also find joy in that, then.
――...If so――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――You said I was cool.
――I request your cooperation on this Mission.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-I understand the situation...! If there's anything I can do...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Let's see... cool photos, right? Maybe we could find a motif from a story――

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: In that case! How about "Ah, Tale of the Verdant Knight" that we were discussing just now!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――...Like this?
Rob Roy, lending me the sword――I thank you.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: You're very welcome... You look truly magnificent! Even though it's a replica, you look like a genuine knight...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Strong, dignified, valiant――Beholding such a knightly figure, your esteemed master will surely be deeply moved!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes! You look wonderful, Chris♪ Your mentor is bound to feel proud desu wa.
While it felt slightly off the mark, seeing how satisfied they all were made me think it was fine as it was.
choice_data_list: (If I were in the mentor's shoes, I'd certainly be delighted.)
(If I were in the mentor's shoes, I'd certainly be delighted.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――A reply letter... arrived from my mentor.
'I am glad to see you living such a fulfilling academy life. The knight photo is cool as well'――it said.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――...I am glad I made it.
